cmd_start_welcome: 🤖 Ingress Group Verification Bot This bot handles entry verification for Ingress-themed groups. New members must pass image recognition verification to gain messaging permissions. Use /help to see available commands.
cmd_help_general: General Commands: /start - Show welcome message /help - Show help information /myid - Get your Telegram User ID
cmd_help_image_sets: Image Set Management (Bot Admin only): /addset <label> - Create a new image set /addimage <label> - Add an image to a set (reply to a photo) /listsets - List all image sets /delset <label> - Delete an image set /setstats - View image count per set /test - Trigger a test verification
cmd_help_admin_mgmt: Bot Admin Management (Existing admins only): /addadmin <user_id> - Add a Bot admin /removeadmin <user_id> - Remove a Bot admin /listadmins - List all Bot admins
cmd_help_permissions: Permissions: • Image set management: Bot admins only • Use /myid to get your User ID • Use /addadmin to add a Bot admin
cmd_myid_response: 👤 Your Telegram User ID: %d Add this ID to the BOT_ADMIN_IDS environment variable to become a Bot admin.
